g.text: 2 · Live data flow: from a spoken sentence to servo targets, and back
dashed border = new component (not in upstream Open Duck) · red = safety path
RB3 Gen 2 (QCS6490): brain, at the booth
Feedback loop: the executor aborts a skill when
telemetry reports 'fallen' or a high tilt, and
confirms out loud when a skill finishes.
Pi Zero 2 W: on the robot (upstream runtime + Jero wrappers)
tilt · fallen · loop dt · mode · battery
